headline: Kai, Warsh warned Jackson Hole the Fed will 'have work to do' on inflation, and by Friday's close a September hike was nearly a coin flip.
subline: Hike odds jumped to 46% after headline PCE ran hot, gold and bitcoin each fell about 3%, and the Nepal–Tibet flood toll neared 400 with 1,500 missing.
asof: Saturday edition · U.S. markets closed · all figures are Friday's close · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Warsh puts a September hike in play
items.sentence: The new Fed chair said policymakers will 'have work to do' if inflation is not clearly returning to 2%, and Yahoo Finance reports markets now price a 46% chance of a September hike, up from 35%.

items.title: Headline PCE hot at 3.7%, core in line
items.sentence: July's headline rate came in at 3.7% against a 3.6% forecast while core held at 3.3%, matching expectations, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: PayPal drops 11% as buyout collapses
items.sentence: Advent and Stripe withdrew from their $50 billion acquisition and PayPal fell 11%, per Yahoo Finance's close report, which also logged gold's 2.90% slide on the rate repricing.

items.title: Bitcoin's 3% slide keeps it below $80,000
items.sentence: Friday's drop to $77,899 leaves bitcoin up 24.33% over the past month but 29.70% below the $112,567 of a year ago, per Fortune and Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Next test: August jobs report Friday
items.sentence: Schaeffer's Research flags Friday's employment report as the week's main event, after ISM manufacturing Tuesday and the Beige Book Wednesday — a quiet Monday is the calendar's only mercy.

items.title: Nepal–Tibet toll passes 390 with 1,500 missing
items.sentence: Al Jazeera reports 392 confirmed dead and more than 1,500 missing, including hundreds of foreign tourists, after Wednesday's glacier collapse sent a wall of water and debris through Nepal's Rasuwa district.

items.title: Iran names its price to reopen Hormuz
items.sentence: Tehran is demanding sanctions relief and compensation before reopening the strait, Al Jazeera reports, and the impasse continues to prop up crude.

items.title: Patriot stocks in Europe 'beyond critical'
items.sentence: An AP exclusive carried by PBS says officials describe U.S. Patriot interceptor stocks in Europe as 'beyond critical' after months of defending against Iranian missile and drone attacks.

items.title: Second Haiti deportation flight in a week
items.sentence: More than 160 deportees from the U.S. and the Bahamas landed in Cap-Haïtien in a single day as removals accelerate after the end of TPS, per the Haitian Times.

items.title: Judge voids Pentagon blacklist of Anthropic
items.sentence: A federal judge ruled the supply-chain-risk designation was unlawful retaliation that violated the First Amendment, The Hill reports.

items.title: Nvidia: $96.2 billion quarter, $108 billion guide
items.sentence: Wednesday's release showed revenue up 106% with data-center sales of $89.0 billion, and a Q3 outlook of $108 billion that excludes China data-center compute, per Nvidia.

items.title: Reddit nearly vanishes from ChatGPT citations
items.sentence: Forbes reports Reddit all but disappeared from ChatGPT citations after an unannounced change to OpenAI's search retrieval.

items.title: OpenAI tells staff: public in 2027
items.sentence: CFO Sarah Friar told employees OpenAI 'will be a public company in 2027' or sooner, per CNBC.
